items.title: NVIDIA: New AI Technology
items.summary: A reasoning model scores thousands of possible continuations before it writes a single token. How much of that uncertainty does a smaller model need to learn from it? New research from NVIDIA asks when a teacher’s strongest predictions are enough and when an unlikely token can change the course of an answer. all rights w/ authors: Effective Teacher Support for Reasoning Distillation Lavinia Ghita, Dhruv Desai from NVIDIA arXiv:2611.14850 #nvidia #discoverai #airesearch #aitechnology

items.title: Predictive AI, AutoML & Tabular Foundation Models: H2O's Core Strength
items.summary: Years of historical data only pay off when they answer forward-looking questions. Which customers will leave? Which transactions are fraudulent? Which equipment is about to fail? Terms covered: - Predictive AI: turning accumulated history into decisions, shifting from reacting after events to acting before them - AutoML: automating algorithm selection, hyperparameter tuning and model comparison. Work that took weeks of specialist time now takes hours, and teams that ran one experiment can run dozens. - Machine learning automation: now extending across feature management, data preparation, deployment and app creation, with agents orchestrating the full lifecycle - Tabular Foundation Model (TFM): pre-trained on vast amounts of structured data, so it generalizes to new datasets faster and needs less labeled data Think of a TFM as the difference between hiring someone with no experience and someone who has already solved thousands of similar problems. — AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAWKlIKS-66E Free courses and certifications: https://h2o.ai/university #PredictiveAI #AutoML #FoundationModels #AIGlossary #H2Oai
items.summary_html:
Years of historical data only pay off when they answer forward-looking questions. Which customers will leave? Which transactions are fraudulent? Which equipment is about to fail?

Terms covered:
- Predictive AI: turning accumulated history into decisions, shifting from reacting after events to acting before them
- AutoML: automating algorithm selection, hyperparameter tuning and model comparison. Work that took weeks of specialist time now takes hours, and teams that ran one experiment can run dozens.
- Machine learning automation: now extending across feature management, data preparation, deployment and app creation, with agents orchestrating the full lifecycle
- Tabular Foundation Model (TFM): pre-trained on vast amounts of structured data, so it generalizes to new datasets faster and needs less labeled data

Think of a TFM as the difference between hiring someone with no experience and someone who has already solved thousands of similar problems.

—
AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University

items.title: Recursive Harness: Self-Improving Agents Without Training
items.summary: How to build a self-evolving agent harness: the agent starts with three tools (shell, read, write) and grows its own tools, lifecycle hooks and memory while it works, on the Gemini Interactions API. I walk through the three-zone architecture, then test it against a frozen harness on web apps, silent bug-report videos and a custom binary format, and show when a self-evolving harness pays off and when it bloats itself. Fish Audio Drama 3 (API): https://fish.audio/?fpr=engineerprompt Harness² Explained: https://youtu.be/pW2ktrJlsyE Gemini 4 Argon, fully tested: https://youtu.be/yksrd5uNxcw What is an Agent Harness?: https://youtu.be/nWzXyjXCoCE This video is sponsored by Fish Audio. #FishAudio 0:00 Can an agent write its own harness? 2:22 What is an agent harness?
